title: Gensou Mangekyou: The Memories of Phantasm

alternative_titles.en: Touhou Fantasy Kaleidoscope: The Memories of Phantasm
alternative_titles.ja: 幻想万華鏡 ~The Memories Of Phantasm~

synopsis:
The series addresses events from Perfect Cherry Blossom, Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, Phantasmagoria of Flower View, Mountain of Faith and Subterranean Animism. It also briefly delves into Cirno's story from Touhou Hisoutensoku.

(Source: Touhou Wiki)
